top_changes.change: Give every pickup and harvest node a distinct, 2-3x larger world silhouette (bottle, scroll/disc for TMs, pack, ore vein, candy tiers by shape+size) with a grounded base and restrained glow instead of interchangeable sparkle dots

Break up the flat uniform pale dune plane and fight arena: add dune ridges/wind ripples at scale, damp darker shoreline bands, driftwood, shrubs and wet rock clusters, and replace the hard grass/sand boundary and the bare grey cliff wall in the fight with dressed salt rock and dune-grass transitions

De-clutter and shrink the fight HUD (five stacked panels cover ~35% of the frame) and replace the flat magenta outline telegraph rings/rectangles with grounded terrain-conforming decals so creatures and tells read through the frame

rows.reason: Most pickups are still tiny (roughly 10-20 px) glowing blobs or sparkles on the sand; trail preserve, TM riptide lance, TM tidal burst and leviathan surge all read as the same small orange-white glowing dot, and travel_pack is barely findable in the grass. Harvest nodes (sluice metal, reef stone) are small grey lumps with no pickup-range silhouette, though tide_bloom's pink flower does read.

Candies are no longer one shared green wrapper: great candy is pale blue, rare candy a glowing yellow, skill candy I/II a dark near-black wrapped form. They are still the same tiny wrapped shape at near-identical scale, and skill candy I vs II are indistinguishable, so tier reads only by hue at close range.

Across the late Riverdrake frames its feet meet the sand/grass with a contact shadow directly under the body and no visible belly sinking; the rearing tell poses also stay planted. No deep crouch/recoil frame is sampled, and on the dark grass slope (t-150, t-159) the shadow merges with terrain so contact is less legible.
